verdict.reason: mean test delta vs baseline = -0.9375 pp on S2 +0.0500 (CI95 0.1526, lower -0.1026), S3 -0.0688 (CI95 0.1487, lower -0.2175); n_test=5; rule >= 0.0200 and both lower > 0 -> FAIL
verdict.gate_rule: mean of S2,S3 test delta vs baseline >= 0.020 AND both paired 95% CI lower > 0
verdict.gate_evaluated_on: primary arm A (slack selector), test seeds 2026111725-2026111729, single pass
verdict.diagnosis: Reserve-only training cannot clear the pre-registered gate on 5 test seeds. The same pairing on the 10 val seeds already gives lower<0 (S2 -0.0059, S3 -0.0228), so the failure is structural, not a test-slice accident: with weights 1-3 the weighted on-time rate moves in lumps of 1/W, 2-3 of 5 seeds are unchanged, and the paired sd (12.3pp / 12.0pp) is 2.5x the effect. The grid corner q0.30 (the best fixed reserve found on val) gives S2 +6.7pp / S3 +0.6pp on the same test seeds, so no reserve-only policy of this family reaches +2.0pp on both cases there. What the two arms do show is an interaction: the learned reserve is nearly constant (level 3 = q0.45, 96% of greedy decisions) under the slack selector, but genuinely state-dependent under the risk selector (q0.35 dominant on S2, q0.30 on S3), and that arm improves S2 by +9.2pp vs slack_old while tying S3.
